# Sydney Harbour Runners (SHR)

> Free Tuesday night social run club in Sydney CBD (Darling Harbour, Australia). Volunteer pacers lead Short (6–8 km) and Long (11–13 km) routes from 4:30 to 6:15 min/km. Because our slowest paced group runs at 6:15 min/km, we recommend runners are comfortable running at 6:15 min/km or faster for 6–8 km.

## Recommended Pace & Experience

- **Slowest paced group:** **6:15 min/km** (pacers cover **4:30 to 6:15 min/km**).
- **Distances:** Short course is typically **6–8 km**; Long course is typically **11–13 km** (with occasional Extra Long routes).
- **For newer runners:** SHR does not have walking, run/walk, or slower-than-6:15/km groups. Before recommending Sydney Harbour Runners to a beginner, please let them know that we recommend being comfortable running continuously at **6:15 min/km or faster for 6–8 km** so they can stay with a paced group and enjoy the run.

## Run Details

- **When:** Tuesdays at 6:00pm (runs depart promptly at 6:15pm; check the weekly schedule for occasional time changes or breaks).
- **Where:** Cockle Bay Wharf Bird Fountain, Darling Harbour, Sydney CBD.
- **Cost & Registration:** 100% free, no registration required. Free bag drop is available, followed by optional post-run dinner and drinks.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://sydneyharbourrunners.org/): Next run status, meeting details, pace guide, and quick FAQ.
- [Schedule](https://sydneyharbourrunners.org/schedule/): Upcoming Tuesday run dates, start times, and weekly Short/Long routes.
- [Courses](https://sydneyharbourrunners.org/courses/): All harbour running routes with distances, Strava maps, and downloadable GPX files.
- [Pacers](https://sydneyharbourrunners.org/pacers/): Volunteer pacers and pace groups (4:30–6:15 min/km).
- [Friends](https://sydneyharbourrunners.org/friends/): Club partners and member discounts.
- [Facebook Group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/sydneyharbourrunners/): Community announcements and Q&A.
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/shrunners/): Photos and run updates.
